authorization.scope: Begin the narrow Change A recovery only; renewed G1 acceptance of the resulting tool remains pending.

protected_workspace_snapshot.algorithm: SHA-256 over canonical JSON records of every repository path outside allowed_recovery_paths, including exists, size and content SHA-256; Git status is separately canonicalized and hashed with the same exclusions.

hard_boundaries: Do not overwrite or replace the original G2 content-frozen baseline.
Do not modify W0-W9, rebuild-draft content, Change B semantics, formal entry points or run-state during recovery.
Only the listed recovery paths may change before renewed G1 acceptance.
A replacement tool digest is usable by content scope only through an append-only approved recovery manifest linking the original and replacement digests.
Renewed G1 acceptance must follow tests, fixtures, real read-only checks, OpenSpec strict validation and independent review; implementation authorization is not acceptance.
